technique_name: Compare and contrast the lifestyles of a vegetarian and a vegan.
description: A vegetarian lifestyle generally involves abstaining from meat and other animal products, eating primarily fruits, vegetables, grains, and legumes, and sometimes dairy products, eggs, and honey. A vegan lifestyle involves abstaining from all animal products, including dairy and eggs, and seeking plant-based alternatives when possible.
